draft_text:
IN THE COURT OF CIVIL JUDGE (SENIOR DIVISION), KOLHAPUR

Civil Suit No. _____ / 2024

Pradeep Desai                          ...Plaintiff
Vs.
Vijay Kulkarni                         ...Defendant

WRITTEN STATEMENT / REPLY ON BEHALF OF DEFENDANT

Date: [DATE]

The Defendant, Vijay Kulkarni, most respectfully submits this Written Statement in reply to the plaint filed by the Plaintiff, Pradeep Desai, and states as under:

PRELIMINARY OBJECTIONS

1. That the present suit is not maintainable in law or on facts.

2. That the sale deed relied upon by the Plaintiff is defective on its face inasmuch as the execution date is not legible/is blank, rendering it invalid as a registered instrument for transfer of immovable property under Section 54 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882.

3. That the 7/12 extract (land record / Satbara Utara) produced by the Plaintiff is blurry and entirely unreadable. No evidentiary value can be attached to such a document. The Defendant reserves the right to object to its admissibility.

REPLY ON MERITS

4. That the Defendant denies each and every averment in the plaint save those specifically admitted herein.

5. That the Defendant is the lawful and peaceful owner in possession of agricultural land bearing Survey No. 45/2, admeasuring 1 acre 20 guntha, situated at Village Shiroli, Taluka Karvir, District Kolhapur (hereinafter referred to as 'the said property').

6. That the Defendant has been in continuous, uninterrupted, and undisputed possession of the said property for over two decades, and the same is duly recorded in his name in the revenue records.

7. That the alleged sale deed produced by the Plaintiff does not bear a legible execution date and therefore does not satisfy the requirements of a valid sale under Section 54 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882, read with the Registration Act, 1908.

8. That the Plaintiff has no legal, valid, or subsisting claim or right over the said property, and the present suit has been filed with a mala fide intention to harass the Defendant and dispossess him of his lawful property.

9. That the Defendant has valid and clear title documents and a duly updated 7/12 extract in his name, copies of which are annexed hereto.

PRAYER

In view of the foregoing, the Defendant most respectfully prays that this Hon'ble Court be pleased to:

(a) Dismiss the Plaintiff's suit with costs;
(b) Declare the Defendant as the lawful owner of the property bearing Survey No. 45/2, Village Shiroli, Taluka Karvir, District Kolhapur;
(c) Pass such other and further orders as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the interest of justice.

Verification:
I, Vijay Kulkarni, the Defendant above-named, do hereby verify that the contents of the above Written Statement are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief, and no part of it is false and nothing material has been concealed therein.

Verified at Kolhapur on this [DATE].

(Vijay Kulkarni)
Defendant

suggested_sections.explanation: Defines 'transfer of property' as an act by which a living person conveys property to one or more other living persons. Establishes the basic requirement for a valid transfer.

Defines 'sale' and 'sale deed' requirements for immovable property. A sale of property of value Rs. 100 and upwards can only be made by a registered instrument. A sale deed without a legible/valid execution date may be challenged.
Documents compulsorily registrable — includes instruments of sale of immovable property. A sale deed must be registered to have legal effect.
Provides for declaratory relief — a court may declare a person's title to property where their right is disputed. Defendant may seek a declaration of ownership.
Sets the limitation period of 12 years for a suit to recover possession of immovable property based on title. Relevant to assess time-barred claims.

client_summary: श्री विजय कुळकर्णी यांना कळवायचे आहे की, प्रतिवादीने दाखल केलेल्या विक्री-पत्रावर तारीख स्पष्ट नाही, त्यामुळे ते दस्तऐवज कायदेशीरदृष्ट्या अवैध ठरू शकते. तसेच समोरच्या पक्षाने दाखल केलेला ७/१२ उतारा अस्पष्ट असून न्यायालयात तो ग्राह्य धरला जाणार नाही. तुमची जमीन सर्व्हे नंबर ४५/२ तुमच्याच नावावर नोंद आहे. तुमच्या वकिलांनी न्यायालयात तुमची बाजू मांडली आहे. एक स्वच्छ ७/१२ उतारा आणि विक्री-पत्राची प्रमाणित प्रत ताबडतोब मिळवा.
